entities.summary: Alan Mak is a British Conservative Party politician who has been the Member of Parliament (MP) for Havant since 2015. He recently served as the Shadow Secretary of State for Science, Innovation and Technology from November 2024 until July 2025. and He served as Parliamentary Under-Secretary of State for Industry and Economic Security and Parliamentary Under-Secretary of State for the Investment Security Unit from March to July 2024.
